verdict.rationale: Stripe documents ACP-style checkout create/update/confirm calls. These move a checkout session through the statuses incomplete, ready_for_payment, completed and others, and the embedded agent mode says Stripe manages "cart management" across the full checkout lifecycle. Both paths are gated: private preview, waitlist onboarding, a seller-initiated OCA, limited geography and physical goods only. Missing for 10: general availability, agent-side request/response detail for the cart create/update call (the evidence mainly shows the seller-side reverse API), and independent or hands-on corroboration of draft creation and updates.
